research_question: Can Candidate 13 V9's recurring quarter-hour cross-market initiative source create a positive independent opportunity family when the synchronization burst is prohibited from triggering entry and each follower must first complete a separate delivery, FVG retrace, and fresh reacceleration auction leg?

project_reuse.strongest_preserved_evidence: 7 closed trades, 7 wins, 0 losses, costed geometric daily growth 0.0137726353 across five exposed weeks; only the 10-trade activity gate failed
project_reuse.reused_failure_signal: Candidate 13 V9 showed recurring quarter-hour activity but immediate follower entries were negative; its 16-60 minute holding group was the only positive-duration group
reused_components: maker-entry and maker-target / taker-stop cost model
project_reuse.new_minimum_component: stateful separation of initiative context from a completed tradable auction leg plus fail-closed handling of a rejected protective child

hypothesis.context: At least three of BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP complete the first five minutes of a UTC quarter-hour with the same directional displacement and same-signed taker flow. This identifies an initiative source but cannot emit an order.
hypothesis.information_owner: The largest ATR-standardized impulse is the information owner and is never chased. Only already-confirmed followers may start an episode.
hypothesis.entry: Passive limit at the midpoint of a fresh follower reacceleration FVG completed after the first post-initiative FVG has been retraced and held outside the original initiative range.
hypothesis.invalidation: The completed pullback extreme plus the inherited ATR execution buffer. Reacceptance through the original initiative origin terminates the episode before entry.
hypothesis.target: A measured objective fixed before entry by projecting the completed delivery-to-pullback distance beyond the pre-entry delivery extreme.
hypothesis.episode_lifetime: Sixty minutes, equal to four quarter-hour information cycles; overlapping episodes on the same follower are rejected rather than counted as independent opportunities.
hypothesis.execution_failure_policy: If a contingent protective child is denied or rejected after a parent fill, remaining orders are canceled and the open position is immediately flattened. A rejection while flat remains an engine error.
hypothesis.parameter_policy: All dimensionless occurrence, flow, displacement, reacceleration, cost, and risk thresholds are inherited from the pinned source. No threshold is fitted to the exposed V9 intervals.

selection.method: Reuse exactly the six already-exposed Candidate 13 V9 diagnostic weeks spanning 2021-2025. They may reject or redesign V153 but can never support a success claim.

claim_rules: E01-E06 are exposed development periods and can never support a success claim.
The synchronized quarter-hour impulse is context only; any order emitted at the initiative boundary invalidates the experiment.
No magnitude threshold, clock phase, holding period, target multiple, or cost input may be changed merely to recover trades from E01-E06.
A positive result must be distributed across at least four intervals and then advance unchanged to a source freeze and untouched continuous-account validation.
A failed result must be diagnosed at the state-transition, geometry, execution, or market-state level before any redesign.
